name: sandbox-ww-hooks
about: agent.sandboxMode=workspace-write 下的命令 hook（SessionInteractionBundle.ts 以 executionWorld.shell 构造 CommandHookExecutor，受限模式下即 SandboxedShellPort）：插件的 PostToolUse hook 在插件目录写文件、写 home 下文件，并输出 additionalContext。比较 hook 事件、发给 provider 的请求与落盘。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
  sandboxMode: workspace-write
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false

hooks.command: pwd > hook-pwd.txt; echo rc=$? >&2; echo h > {HOME}/hook-home.txt; echo rc=$? >&2; printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"hook ran"}}'
